title.narrative: United we stand, divided we fall

description.narrative: Before gaining independence in 2011, South Sudan has been at war for over fifty years. The prolonged war denied the South Sudanese communities and families a chance to live together as clans or communities and enjoy peace, hence the high rampant cases of violence among communities members and domestic violence. Moreover 90% of the current South Sudanese were born in war conflicts and have either experienced or participated in war. This 90% has therefore not experience peace and love and their mind is stocked with war conflict memories. The same percentage of population has been traumatized for a long period. The Gogrial West County communities in Warrap State has not experience peace which makes them suffer from peace deficiency and are not able to demonstrate peace to their neighbouring communities and Gogrial West County at large. This being the major reason for the high rate of community clashes in Warrap State. The Justice & Peace Commission of the Catholic Diocese of Wau has a track record of conflict mitigation in the area. In the year 2013 it established the Justice & Peace Committee in the Parish of Kaujok which operates through its centres which is spread across some payams in Gogrial West, namely, Kuac North; Kuac South; Alek North; Alek West and Riau. Gogrial West according to South Sudan Centre for Census (SSCC) of year 2010 stated that Gogrial West has a population 243,921 and it covers an area of 4,754.37 (sq km). The above mentioned areas are characterized by continue inter – clan clashes which is mainly triggered by resource base conflict, political influence, traditional marriage and constant cattle raiding being practice across the ethnic divide. These had given rise to insecurity in the area including the rampant violation of human rights which comes as a result of the violence in the area. Justice & Peace Commission based on its experience in the parish of Koujok, would like to play a bigger role to achieve peaceful coexistence among difference clans in Gogrial West, especially the volatile area which this inter – clan clashes is on the rise. The involvement of the main players in resolving the sticking issue is vital, and this includes youth, community leaders (traditional and politician) and women. These stockholders hold the keys to finding immediate solution to the conflict if they are empowered. The underlay key issues of the conflict in the area are as follows: • Inter – clan clashes • Cattle raiding • Conflict emerging of the traditional marriage • Resources based conflict • Political misconception • Revenge Attack The most affected members of the community who at time are not involve in fuel the conflict are the women, elderly and the children. So, in the project they are people who will mostly benefit from this support, since through it a peaceful co existence among the communities will ensure peace and stability. Justice & Peace Commission believe and have the conviction that over the period of three year from the start of the implementation of the project, peace will be realize in that part of Gogrial West County. The organization foresee to commence the project as from December 2015 and CAFOD will play the role of a supporting donor funding for the project.
